subject: angol
title: Helping others
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a segítségnyújtásról és a társadalmi felelősségvállalásról.

scenes.description: On a cold winter evening, a group of secondary school students are volunteering at a soup kitchen in a city centre. Wearing aprons and plastic gloves, they are serving hot soup and bread to a long line of homeless people. A teacher is organising the queue, and one boy is chatting with an old man who is holding a cup of tea in both hands. The students look serious but proud.

A young woman in her twenties is helping her elderly neighbour up the staircase of an old block of flats. She is carrying two heavy shopping bags, while the old lady is holding on to the handrail and talking to her. A small dog is following them up the stairs. It seems to be an everyday, informal favour between neighbours.

prompts: Compare the two ways of helping people shown in the pictures.
Why do people choose to help others, and what do they get in return?
Whose responsibility is it to take care of people in need: the state's, charities' or individuals'?
followUpQuestions: Do you think the compulsory community service for Hungarian secondary school students is a good idea? Why?
Why do some people find it difficult to ask for help?
Do people help their neighbours less today than in the past? Why?
What kinds of voluntary work would suit teenagers best?

usefulPhrases.en: give something back to the community
It gives you a sense of satisfaction.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures show people helping others, but one situation is organised and the other is spontaneous. In the first picture, a group of secondary school students are volunteering at a soup kitchen on a cold winter evening. They're wearing aprons and gloves and serving hot soup to a long line of homeless people, and one boy is chatting with an old man. The second picture shows a young woman carrying two heavy shopping bags for her elderly neighbour up the stairs of an old block of flats, while a small dog follows them.
In both cases, people are giving their time to someone in need, but the first is a planned activity, probably organised by the school, whereas the second is an everyday favour. I think people help others because it makes them feel useful, and they often get more in return than they expect. When I did my community service at a food bank in Szeged, I realised how lucky I am. In my view, the state has the main responsibility for people in need, but charities and individuals can fill the gaps.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do people help their neighbours less today than in the past? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'm afraid they do, especially in big cities. People move more often and work long hours, so many of them don't even know their neighbours' names. In my grandparents' village, it's still completely different.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a két jelenet leírása után a vizsgázó megnevezi a hasonlóságot és a különbséget (szervezett kontra spontán segítség), elmagyarázza, miért segítenek az emberek, saját közösségi szolgálati élményt hoz, és állást foglal a felelősség kérdésében.
Szókincs: pontos szavak (soup kitchen, volunteering, an everyday favour, community service, food bank, fill the gaps) és világos szerkezet (In both cases, whereas, In my view).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos szerkezetek hibátlanul – szenvedő szerkezet (organised by the school), 'whereas', 'they often get more in return than they expect', 'When I did …, I realised …' és 'many of them don't even know'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „one situation is organised and the other is spontaneous”, „get more in return than they expect”, „fill the gaps”, „I'm afraid they do”.
